Docs.title: Help & FAQ
Docs.subtitle: Everything you need to know about booking courts and coaches on PlaySlot.
Docs.q1: How do I book a court?
Docs.a1: Search by city, sport, date and time — from the homepage or the search icon in the header — then pick a free slot at a club and confirm. You can pay online by card or on-site at the club.
Docs.q2: Can I book a coach together with my court?
Docs.a2: Yes. When you select a free slot, if the club has coaches available for it you can add one to the same booking — one reservation, no separate back-and-forth.
Docs.q3: How do I cancel or change a booking?
Docs.a3: Open My Bookings and cancel the reservation from there. Any refund follows the club's own cancellation policy, and the club, coach and you are all notified automatically.
Docs.a4: Yes — create a free account and verify your email before your first booking.
Docs.q5: I'm a coach or a club — how do I get set up?
Docs.a5: Coaches manage their profile and schedule from Coach Hub once linked to a club. Clubs are set up and managed by staff through the admin console. Reach out via our Contact page and we'll help you get onboarded.
